2292-2317-7084-8345.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

4279-4314-5332--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4314-5332--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2390-6191-8206.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6191-8206.description:
Gain life.
Unflinching Hortimancer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

549-5412-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-5412-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
549-5412-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6199-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

603-4247-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
603-4247-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7156.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7156.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-4247-7213.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

2173-4905-5220-7918.description:
Cast Fanatical Firebrand by paying its mana cost.
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3413-4875-6446.description:
Activate Silvar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Silvar ability.
Repeat.

3652-3661-5860-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
3652-3661-5860-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

215-3443-6791.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-6791.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-6791.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7724.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wakandan Royal Guard.
When Wakandan Royal Guard dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wakandan Royal Guard enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1367-2334-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Blink Sanar using Soulherder. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-2334-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

813-957-7339.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2034-4017-4772-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4017-4772-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

4375-5330-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

4481-4831-5166.description:
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it, dealing damage to any target.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

539-2783-4050-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2100-4613-5643-6586.easyPrerequisites:
You've cast a spell this turn.
You've had a Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
2100-4613-5643-6586.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Geralf triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Rogue for each other Zombie that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Zombie Rogue using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Repeat.
2100-4613-5643-6586.notes: The mana cost assumes you've had only one Zombie enter the battlefield this turn. If you've had two enter, the cost becomes {5}{R} instead. If you've had three or more enter, the cost becomes {4}{R} instead.

4214-5189-5439-6753.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4214-5189-5439-6753.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

252-2073-5686--90.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
252-2073-5686--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat.

944-2511-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
944-2511-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
944-2511-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1247-5963-6478.description:
Activate Marvin using Arbor Adherent's ability by tapping it, adding four mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1429-4875-5256-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4875-5256-5402.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1978-3941-4694.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat

457-2047-5491.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, create a token copy of Worldwalker Helm plus a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Worldwaker Helm and a Map, adding {U}{U}.
Activate a Worldwalker Helm by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Worldwalker Helm token plus a Map token for each Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-2047-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

855-1651-3715-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
855-1651-3715-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

262-2178-4727.notablePrerequisites: Elemental Mastery and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature with power 1 or greater that does not have summoning sickness.
262-2178-4727.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
The Elemental(s) enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Elemental(s) die, the creature with Thornbite Staff attached triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Repeat.

168-372-2705.description:
Cast Suspension Field by paying {1}{W}.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Oblivion Ring to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Suspension Field.
When Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Oblivion Ring and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Suspension Field to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

104-2060-2625-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Cleric Class is at least level two.
Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Kibo.
104-2060-2625-4222.description:
Activate Kibo by tapping it, creating a Banana artifact token.
Activate the Banana by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/G} and causing you to gain 3 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kibo.
Repeat.

175-1648-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-1648-4222.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

2433-2440-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2433-2440-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Rosie and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the Rosie ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-1722-4050-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-1722-4050-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeating the process one additional time if you control at least eight lands.
Nadir Kraken triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the second Nadir Kraken trigger, if applicable, choosing not to pay.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Repeat.

15-719-1339-5231.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Xenograft.
You have a way to draw a card.
15-719-1339-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

298-2265-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Angelic Quartermaster.
Angelic Quartermaster enters the battlefield, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite and any other creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be used to activate abilities.
Repeat.
